archetypes.name: dyn-codex-role-routing
archetypes.rationale: Codex role routing touches many launcher and retry paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Codex model-role routing across agents.py, agent_waterfall.py, collector retries, and voter dispatch. Check that cheap roles are only used at scoped review, vote, and fix call sites and that default implementer, brainstorm, negotiation, and generic waterfall paths remain strong. Pay special attention to retry metadata preserving model roles and voter slot-output binding by manifest identity. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
